references.text: Psalm 14:1-3 describes humanity's wickedness and that no one is good, which resonates with Jesus' statement that no one is good except God.
Romans 3:10-12 quotes Psalm 14 and 53 to emphasize that no one is righteous on their own, which corresponds with Jesus' point that only God is good.
Isaiah 64:6 speaks of human righteousness as filthy rags, underscoring that human goodness cannot be compared with God's goodness.
